description: The check every trade passes before it is placed. Give it a token, an order size and optionally your rules. It runs the CoinGraph check, measures the real on-chain price impact of your size (DEX aggregator quote) against order-book depth and daily volume, reads leverage, onchain flows and contract risk, and returns ALLOW, REDUCE (with the largest safe size) or BLOCK, with every reason sourced. Returns one of: ALLOW / REDUCE / BLOCK, with a plain summary, structured result, sourced reasons and a proof id. Price: 5 tADA on testnet (premium).

max_impact_pct.description: Largest acceptable price impact; default 1% for top-20 tokens, 2% otherwise

token.description: Token: CoinGecko id (chainlink), symbol (LINK) or contract address
